title: Isolate accessibility-feedback store from live home directory in tests
goal: Close the last known test-isolation bypass left as residual D9 by task 99ccc12f (Isolate API tests from live engine state files; see docs/tasks/99ccc12f-7d71-4781-9b81-9d2902367fba/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section D9): api/routes/accessibility.js resolveFeedbackFile() falls back to live ~/.kainbain/accessibility-feedback.jsonl with no KAINBAIN_* env override and no VITEST guard, bypassing the throwIfLiveEnginePathUnderTest guard in api/flow/resolveStatePath.js (which only covers ~/.kainbain/engine/). Any suite hitting the fallback reads/writes live user data, and api/routes/accessibility.test.js:271-274 still asserts the live fallback path -- the exact bug shape 99ccc12f fixed in durableState.test.js. Work: add a KAINBAIN_ACCESSIBILITY_FEEDBACK_FILE (or dir) override read by resolveFeedbackFile, pin it to a temp path in api/testSetup.isolation.js, extend the under-test guard to cover it, and update the test to assert the throw/temp path instead of the live path. Success: full api suite green with the guard active and no test able to touch ~/.kainbain/accessibility-feedback.jsonl.
